To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
learning is possible at both levels: at the level of establishment and at the level of an individual.

1) the establishment can be considered as a learning organization if the following characteristics are fulfilled: thinking systems, mental models, personal mastery, shared vision, team learning, 2) the learning process of a person can be improved by the use of the division into mental, practical, personality traits and by the use of Bloom's taxonomy and Niemierka's taxonomy, 3) training methods and organizational solutions are of great importance in the process of learning, 4) the use of
the process of learning at the level of establishment is possible only when the establishment is a learning organization, which is a system that continuously learns and adapts to its environment.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the learning process of an individual and an establishment as a whole.
the issue of learning in the context of process safety and occupational health.
the question: what can be done in the process of education to make it possible to learn and to learn effectively.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the learning process in the area of process safety, which is a part of occupational safety and occupational health management, should take place in the establishment and in the individual.
the learning of the establishment and the learning of the individual should go hand in hand.
the process safety is an important element of the learning organization, which can be used as a basis for further research.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the process safety education should be based on the use of a wide range of training methods.
learning is a process that is possible to achieve and to measure, both at the level of an establishment and at the level of individuals.
we should not forget that the key to the prevention of accidents is to learn from them, but also to learn from the experience of others and the use of the most advanced methods and concepts.
The main takeaway from our work is that
learning should be continuous and systematic, both on the level of the establishment and at the individual level.
learning at the level of individual people and at the level of an entire establishment should be treated as a process, which requires a constant and systematic approach.
learning is a process that should not be taken for granted.
